name: Heather Faith
description: Warm, steady mid-low female voice with subtle rasp and grounded authority. Emotionally nuanced, restrained, and authentic. Intimate without fragility; strong without theatrics.

name: Kaisa - Strong and authoritative
description: A powerful, resonant voice of a middle-aged Finnish woman. She speaks with a commanding, steady presence and a mature Nordic accent that conveys deep confidence, experience, and grounded strength.

name: Eden - Warm tone storyteller
description: Eden is a warm, deep, and slightly raspy voice crafted for storytelling. She brings emotion, intimacy, and depth to every script, making her perfect for romance, narration, dramatic reads, and character-driven content. name: Camilla Montgomery
description: She has a warm, rich, alto voice. A little husky. Very clear diction and dramatic interpretation.  Mid pacing, ideal for characters that need that retro movie star flavor.

name: Tess - Direct and Grounded
description: A calm, velvety voice that flows easily. It has an intimate yet expansive quality, perfect for setting the mood in a trailer or a dramatic opening.
